build_conv_sequence: build a conv stride or dilation sequence from an int or list given ndim and channel_index
convert_convolution_dimension_numbers: convert a XLA ConvolutionDimensionNumbers proto message to JAX ConvDimensionNumbers
convert_dot_dimension_numbers: convert a XLA DotDimensionNumbers proto message to JAX DotDimensionNumbers

map_random_algorithm: map a TensorFlow random algorithm enum value to the corresponding XLA random algorithm enum
